title: Figure 6: Thick-source effect (not to scale) - source volume, slit system, detector plane
description: Color geometric diagram of a cylindrical "Source Volume" with points A, B and central point C, tilted at angle θ, sending colored ray paths through apertures a of a "Slit System" (separation d, distance Lxs) to a "Detector Plane" point x1 at distance Lsd, with x/z axes and an arrow P. The caption reads "Figure 6. Thick-Source Effect (not to scale)" and explains that waves from the extrema A and B may have significant path and phase differences while waves from C are in phase. It appears in Section V, Coherence-Entanglement Complementarity.
